Format averages (higher is better): {"family_bond": {"n": 3, "avg": 55.5}, "lok_katha": {"n": 1, "avg": 59.39}}
Lessons:
- Prioritize 'lok_katha' (folklore) formats over serialized drama; it delivers the highest average engagement score (59.39 vs 55.5) and generates saves.
- Hook with specific, eerie times and real locations (e.g., 'Raat ke dhai baje, Raniganj...') to drive the strongest raw views.
- Settings centered on cursed village relics ('Jamni gaon ka kuan') and deserted transit ('sunsaan sadak par bus') clearly resonate best with this audience.
- Avoid weak recap hooks like 'Pichhle part mein...', which caused significant view drops in subsequent episodes of multi-part series.
- Eliminate reliance on slow-burn episodic cliffhangers; standalone stories or high-stakes standalone twists are needed to fix near-zero shares and comments.

story_log.title: Kosi Gaon ka Safed Peepal
story_log.setting: Navgarh village - mud-brick houses, misty mustard fields, and an ancient stepwell under a glowing full moon.
story_log.entity: Nishi Daak (a midnight entity that calls children using a mother's voice)
story_log.protagonist: Meera, 19, a protective elder sister living with her Dadi and 8-year-old brother, Chhotu.
story_log.emotion: A sister's desperate bravery and a grandmother's tragic, protective secret.

story_log.title: Chhatarpur ka Ulti Pailo Kuan
story_log.setting: Orachha-adjacent village of Jamni – mud-brick houses, dry canal, a moonlit ancient stepwell (kuan) surrounded by thick babool trees.
story_log.entity: Pichhal-Pairi (the backward-footed entity of the stepwell)
story_log.emotion: A bride's selfless devotion and a mother-in-law's sacrifice.

story_log.title: Almora Bypass ka Safed Dhund
story_log.setting: A narrow, fog-choked mountain bypass near an isolated pine forest late at night during a winter storm.
story_log.entity: Chhal (a Pahadi shape-shifting mountain spirit that mimics loved ones in fog)
story_log.protagonist: Karan, 22, driving his ailing father Ramesh, 54, back from a valley hospital at 2:30 AM.
story_log.emotion: A father's quiet, unconditional protection and a final goodbye.
